items.summary: Expand Fred’s offline Clash Royale knowledge base significantly beyond the current topics so he can answer a much broader range of Clash Royale questions (while remaining fully deterministic and fully local with zero network calls). Add substantial new topic coverage (with keywords + synonyms + answers) for common cards, archetypes, matchups, ladder fundamentals, progression terms, and practical decision-making scenarios, so users experience a clear capability jump compared to the current limited deck answers.

Improve Fred’s ability to answer deck-related questions by adding deterministic deck-question handling that can recognize when a user provides a deck list (8 cards or near-8 cards) or asks for deck feedback, and return a structured response (identified win condition(s), likely archetype, strengths, weaknesses, and concrete improvement suggestions) based on a local, static set of rules and card-role mappings.

Enhance Fred’s deterministic matching so common deck/card phrasing is routed to the right answers more reliably, including handling card-name variations, punctuation, pluralization, and common shorthand (e.g., “xbow” vs “x-bow”, “gy” vs “graveyard”), while preserving deterministic behavior.

Update the Ask Fred UI helper text (welcome intro and in-chat helper text) and the Fred disclaimer copy (where currently shown) so the app clearly communicates the upgraded coverage while still being accurate: Fred remains an offline, deterministic helper (not ChatGPT), may not know everything, and will ask clarifying questions when needed.
